definition: A rupture in the established order of a situation that names what was previously invisible — the event brings into appearance that which was excluded from the situation's count-as-one; it cannot be deduced from or predicted by the situation's existing knowledge (the encyclopedia), and its occurrence is always retroactively affirmed through the fidelity of subjects who decide that it happened
connective_patterns: the event names the void of the situation
the event is undecidable from within the situation
the event supplemented by the name it gives itself

definition: The infinite process by which a subject, faithful to an event, draws out its consequences within a situation, producing a generic subset that pierces the established knowledge; there are exactly four domains of truth procedures — politics, science, art, and love — each capable of generating genuine novelty irreducible to the encyclopedia of the situation
connective_patterns: truth procedures unfold in politics, science, art, and love
the truth procedure produces a generic subset
truth is the infinite result of a finite event

definition: The sustained commitment to an event — the operator by which a subject locally discerns connections and disconnections of multiples in the situation to the name of the event; fidelity is not passive belief but active, ongoing investigation of what the event implies for the situation, generating the truth procedure through continued militant engagement
connective_patterns: fidelity as the sustained tracing of the event's consequences
fidelity generates the truth procedure
the subject constituted through fidelity to the event

definition: Adapted from Paul Cohen's mathematical technique, forcing is the means by which a subject anticipates truths not yet fully constituted within a situation — the subject forces statements about the still-incomplete generic truth by hypothetically assuming its completion, thereby projecting what would be true in a transformed situation even before that transformation is achieved
connective_patterns: forcing as anticipation of an incomplete truth
forcing adapted from Cohen's independence proofs
the subject forces new knowledge from fidelity to the event

definition: A truth is a generic subset — a multiple whose singularity eludes all classification by the predicates of the encyclopedia; the generic contains an element from each subset of the situation while being irreducible to any particular property, making it a truth that belongs to the situation universally precisely because it is indiscernible by any established means of distinction
connective_patterns: a truth is generic because it evades all predicative classification
the generic subset intersects every subset of the situation
the generic as the mathematical model of universality

definition: The proper name of being — the empty set (Ø) that is the foundational element of every situation; the void is what the situation's structure cannot present but which is nevertheless sutured to it as its unpresented ground; the event names the void by drawing attention to what the situation's count-as-one has excluded
connective_patterns: the void as the proper name of being
the event names the void of the situation
the void is what the state of the situation cannot count

definition: Any structured presentation of multiplicity — a consistent count-as-one that organizes multiples into a coherent domain; every situation has a state (metastructure) that re-counts its elements, securing consistency; the gap between the situation's presentation and its state's re-presentation is where the possibility of the event lurks
connective_patterns: every situation has a state that re-counts it
the gap between situation and state
the situation structured by the count-as-one

definition: Not a pre-given entity but the bearer of a truth procedure, constituted through fidelity to an event — the subject comes into being only through commitment to tracing the consequences of an event within a situation; Badiou identifies three subjective figures: the faithful subject (truth), the reactive subject (denial), and the obscure subject (occultation)
connective_patterns: the subject constituted through fidelity to the event
the subject as bearer of a truth procedure
faithful, reactive, and obscure subjective figures

definition: Pure inconsistent multiplicity without organizing structure, overall unity, or centering basis — Badiou's fundamental ontological thesis is that 'the One is not' and that being qua being is mathematically thought through Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory; ontology is mathematics, and what is presented in any situation is always a multiple of multiples
connective_patterns: ontology is mathematics (set theory)
the One is not — being is pure multiplicity
being is thought through ZFC set theory

definition: The fundamental mode of being — everything that is is a multiple of multiples, with no ultimate atomic unity; Badiou distinguishes consistent multiplicity (structured by the count-as-one in a situation) from inconsistent multiplicity (pure being without structure), and the tension between them is the ontological ground of the event
connective_patterns: being is irreducibly multiple
consistent vs. inconsistent multiplicity
the count-as-one structures multiplicity into a situation

definition: The result of the count-as-one operation that structures pure multiplicity into a presented situation — consistency is not a property of being itself but the effect of the structuring operation that makes a situation cohere; the state of the situation provides a second count that secures consistency against the threat of underlying inconsistency
connective_patterns: consistency as the effect of the count-as-one
the state secures consistency through re-counting
consistency threatened by the void

definition: The totality of established knowledge within a situation — the system of classifications, predicates, and distinctions by which the state of a situation organizes and controls what is knowable; a truth is precisely that which exceeds the encyclopedia, being generic and therefore unclassifiable by any existing predicate
connective_patterns: truth makes a hole in knowledge
the encyclopedia cannot classify a generic truth
the encyclopedia as the state's regime of knowledge

definition: The decisive act by which a subject recognizes and names an event — since the event is undecidable from within the situation's resources, intervention is the wager that the event has indeed occurred and that its name is legitimate; intervention is the founding gesture of any truth procedure, inaugurating the fidelity that will trace the event's consequences
connective_patterns: intervention as the naming of the event
intervention as an undecidable wager
intervention inaugurates the truth procedure

definition: An infinite, generic subset of a situation produced through a truth procedure faithful to an event — truth is not correspondence, coherence, or pragmatic success but the result of a militant process that punches a hole in established knowledge; truth is always the truth of a particular situation, universal precisely because it is indiscernible by the situation's own predicates
connective_patterns: truth as generic and indiscernible
truth punches a hole in knowledge
truth is the infinite result of fidelity to an event

term: state of the situation/情势的状态
definition: The metastructure that re-counts and secures the elements of a situation; the state is the power set of the situation, representing all possible subsets rather than just elements. The gap between situation and state (belonging vs. inclusion) is where the event can occur
connective_patterns: the state re-counts the situation's elements
the excess of the state over the situation

definition: That which cannot be distinguished by any predicate of the encyclopedia; a truth is indiscernible because it is generic. It contains representatives from every subset but cannot be specified by any property. The indiscernible is universal precisely because it escapes all classification
connective_patterns: a truth is indiscernible by the encyclopedia
the indiscernible as the form of universality

definition: The fundamental operation that structures pure multiplicity into a consistent situation; the count-as-one is not a pre-existing unity but an operation that retroactively produces the effect of unity. Without the count, there is only inconsistent multiplicity
connective_patterns: the count-as-one structures multiplicity into a situation
what is presented is always the result of the count

definition: The philosophical operation by which truth is separated from the dominant regime of opinion, knowledge, and power. Rather than negating and sublating, a truth subtracts itself from the state of the situation, operating in the gap between the count and what escapes counting
connective_patterns: truth operates by subtraction from the encyclopedia
subtraction rather than dialectical negation

definition: Badiou's theory of the relation between philosophy and art: philosophy neither produces, instructs, nor classifies art, but thinks art as an autonomous truth procedure. Philosophy identifies the truths that art produces without philosophically subsuming artistic production
connective_patterns: inaesthetics thinks art as a truth procedure
art is a condition of philosophy, not its object

definition: The relation between philosophy and politics: philosophy thinks the truths that political sequences produce, without prescribing action. Metapolitics is neither political philosophy (judging politics by philosophical standards) nor philosophy of the political (treating politics as an object)
connective_patterns: metapolitics thinks political truths at a distance
metapolitics is neither prescription nor description

definition: In Logics of Worlds (2006), a world is the framework of appearance: the transcendental organization that determines the degrees of intensity with which multiples appear. Worlds replace the set-theoretical situation with a logic of appearing governed by a transcendental algebra
connective_patterns: a world organizes degrees of appearing
the transcendental of a world determines intensities of existence

definition: An element of a world whose degree of appearing is minimal (zero intensity); it exists ontologically as a multiple but does not appear. The event consists precisely in the maximal appearing of what was previously an inexistent, transforming the world's logical structure
connective_patterns: the event brings the inexistent into maximal appearance
the inexistent exists but does not appear

definition: In Logics of Worlds, the material support of a truth procedure: the set of elements organized under a new subjective formalism after an event. Not the biological body but the material reality of truth deployment: the party in politics, the movement in art, the research program in science
connective_patterns: the body is the material support of a truth
truth requires a body to have worldly efficacy

definition: The dominant ideology of late capitalism defined as the thesis 'there are only bodies and languages.' It reduces all existence to the cultural-biological nexus, denying truths that exceed the encyclopedia. Badiou opposes to it the materialist dialectic: 'there are only bodies and languages, except that there are truths'
connective_patterns: democratic materialism says there are only bodies and languages
the exception of truth breaks democratic materialism

definition: Badiou's own position: 'there are only bodies and languages, except that there are truths.' The exception of truth ruptures the closed world of democratic materialism; truths are neither bodies nor languages but universal, infinite processes that perforate the finitude of any given world
connective_patterns: the materialist dialectic asserts the exception of truth
truths are neither bodies nor languages

definition: Philosophy's four conditions are the four domains of truth: politics, science, art, and love. Philosophy does not produce truths but composes and thinks the truths its conditions produce. It must not be sutured (reduced) to any single condition
connective_patterns: philosophy is conditioned by its four truth procedures
the four conditions: politics, science, art, love

definition: The pathological reduction of philosophy to one of its four conditions: sutured to politics it becomes ideology, to science positivism, to art aestheticism, to love obscurantism. Philosophy must think all four simultaneously without collapsing into any one
connective_patterns: suture reduces philosophy to a single condition
positivism is philosophy sutured to science

definition: The tradition of thinkers (Nietzsche, Wittgenstein, Lacan) who challenge philosophy's claim to think truths by appealing to what exceeds philosophical discourse: life, silence, the act. Badiou takes anti-philosophy seriously but defends philosophy's capacity to compose truths across its four conditions
connective_patterns: anti-philosophy challenges philosophy from the position of the act
Lacan as anti-philosopher

definition: One of philosophy's four conditions: not romantic sentimentality but the construction of a truth about the Two, a scene in which the world is experienced from the perspective of difference rather than identity. Love produces a truth about existing as two rather than as one
connective_patterns: love is a truth procedure about the Two
love experiences the world from the perspective of difference

definition: A concept from Lacan designating what can be integrally transmitted in formalized discourse. Badiou extends it to ontology: since ontology is mathematics, the matheme is the mode in which being is thought, guaranteeing universal transmissibility unlike the ineffable claims of phenomenology or hermeneutics
connective_patterns: the matheme is integrally transmissible
ontology as matheme
